newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel flat to touch softer, quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel flat to touch softer, quiet.

text.p: Steady crude futures and a balanced market in the straight run fuel sector resulted in broadly unchanged prices on Monday.
Low sulphur straight run saw a wide spread between buyers and sellers. "There's little pressure to sell or buy at the moment," said one trader. Prices were assessed either side of $145 cif NWE.

Russian high sulphur straight run was well supplied with a 1.5 percent water content M-40 cargo selling between $109-110 cif NWE. A low water M-100 was offered "optimistically" in the morning at $116 cif. E-4s held steady around $132 cif NWE with a a cargo loading today and on Nov 10 still looking for homes.
